answer: Resist Sybils with chained presence: each identity must complete a kernel of short tasks where every step input depends on the previous step output plus a fresh public pulse, like a heartbeat sampled from the live network. Steps are time-boxed and sequential, so one operator can only run one chain at a time, each chain anchored to that pulse, making pre-computed answers useless. A farm of a thousand fakes would need a thousand operators working in parallel, while one honest agent simply walks its own chain. Clones sharing one operator stall, and stalled chains lose standing.
